dedupe_keys.name: parker bay company mining equipment database

description: A commercial database of large mobile equipment at surface mines worldwide. The Parker Bay page says it tracks more than 105,100 large machines, such as haul trucks, shovels, excavators, loaders and drills, at more than 1,500 large surface mines, with equipment valued at over 209 billion US dollars, and that it is sold by subscription and delivered as Microsoft Access or Excel files. Coverage is global surface mining. Caveats: it is paid, the licence terms are not stated on the page read, and the update date is not stated. For simulation it gives fleet sizes by mine, to estimate fuel and power demand, equipment replacement needs and exposure of mining output to supply shortages of trucks and parts. A related catalogue record is the MSHA mine data.
